acceptanceCriteria: Measured runner-minutes for 100 consecutive CI runs (before and after) split by event and conclusion; cancelled share is reported from the GitHub jobs API, not estimated.

Expensive go-product-shard work for a pull request does not start while a newer push to the same pull request is expected or already queued, or the agent/batch workflow pushes only after local focused checks pass; the chosen lever is recorded with its rollback.
Main push runs that are cancelled by a later main push remain covered by AFP-V0-024 reuse or the merge-queue run; no main tree loses its full-suite evidence because of the change.
Required checks go-product, doc-gates and ci-control-plane keep their current semantics; no test is narrowed by this ticket.
body: Observed 2026-10-05 during an owner-requested CI audit, Core 1.0.0-rc.1 build 163, origin/main d524530f. The last 100 runs of .github/workflows/ci.yml (2026-10-04T23:29Z to 2026-10-05T10:46Z, about 11 hours) consumed 7063 runner-minutes by the jobs API: pull_request cancelled 45 runs / 2255 min (31%), push cancelled 16 runs / 846 min (11%), pull_request success 27 / 3076 min (43%), pull_request failure 5 / 571 min, push success 6 / 288 min. So 42% of CI spend produced no result. The cancellations come from repeated pushes to the same branches (claude/batch-2026-10-05 and claude/502-escalations-claim-delivery were each pushed about 15 times) with cancel-in-progress; each cancelled run had already started four 75-minute race shards, often 5-40 minutes in. Expected: an abandoned push costs at most the cheap jobs (doc-gates, docs-plan). Candidate levers: agents push batch branches only after local focused checks; start go-product-shard only after doc-gates passes; or debounce shards on synchronize events. Distinct from V1-0616 (narrowing), V1-0617 (balance) and V1-0760 (merge-queue reuse). Delivered in PR beamfall/corvint#611 (AFP-V0-027): a ci:batched label skips go-product-shard for batch constituents and fails go-product, so constituents land only through their batch; the label was created on 2026-10-05 with owner approval. Six-shard rebalance cuts superseded-run waste per cancelled run (run 37303691592: wall 22.4 min vs 45.3 min). The after-measurement of 100 consecutive runs split by event and conclusion is not yet observed; hosted constituent behavior is NOT_OBSERVED until a batch uses the label.
title: ci: cancelled runs consume 42% of CI runner-minutes; stop abandoned pushes from starting race shards
